items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: From the Weems band, Morehouse went to various other dance units in the 1920s. Among them, the orchestras of Paul Whiteman, Jean Goldkette and Red Nichols and His Five Pennies.

ctx.x: I'm aware that they played Atlantic City. I don't know anything about it now.
Paul Whiteman was playing there at the time.
